get.description: The summary of any ref, by `kind`: a provider, register, variable, classification, `class` (every classification) or a group (`group/<provider>/<register>/<key>`, `group/class/<key>`); no ref is the catalog root. A register lists its variables, groups and variants; a classification its owning variables. `ref` is a FQID or a bare name; a retired FQID answers for its successor, under the successor's `fqid`.

The summary of any ref, by `kind`: a provider, register, variable, classification, `class` (every classification) or a group (`group/<provider>/<register>/<key>`, `group/class/<key>`); no ref is the catalog root. A register lists its variables, groups and variants; a classification its owning variables. `ref` is a FQID or a bare name; a retired FQID answers for its successor, under the successor's `fqid`.
The catalog's branding, identity and headline counts, for the SPA.
One documentation entry by variable name or filename (with or without `.md`): its register, tags and source, a 500-character `excerpt` and the full markdown `body`.
A related document's bytes, served inline.

A register's related documents (rehosted PDFs): title, source, license, and the `sha256` and `byte_size` of the bytes `/api/docs/file/{ref}/{filename}` serves. `ref` is a register FQID or a bare name.

Search the catalog's registers, variables, classifications and codes in one ranked list. `q` is free text; `type` keeps one kind of hit; `register` (a FQID or a bare name) and `period` (2019, 2015..2019, LA2019, 2019-03) filter; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

A variable's states: each representation it was delivered in, with its variant, bounds, column, coding and the ids of the data warnings that apply to it. Without `period`, the whole history; with `period`, the dated states overlapping it, a state's alias windows standing in for it where they overlap. `variant` and `value_set_version` (`_none` for the empty label) narrow the list. In holdings scope, only what is held, clipped to the held periods. `ref` is a variable FQID or a bare name.

A register's or variable's data warnings, ordered by id: a variable's include its register's unassigned ones. `period`, `variant` and `representation` (a delivery column) keep the warnings that may apply to them; `unassigned_only` keeps the register's unassigned ones. In holdings scope, a variable's warnings apply only to what is held.

Classification.description: A classification edition. Its codes are `values`, its edition chain `graph`.

dimensions.description: The classification groups it belongs to.

oneOf.description: The succession family it belongs to.

variables.description:
The variables in scope with a state coded by it (today's `get classification
--variables`), unpaged.

ClassificationRoot.description:
Every current classification, with the classification groups and families.
Editions a family stands for are reached through it.

ConceptGroup.description: A register's concept group: its members in scope.

Conformance.description:
The delivered domain against its declared classification; the mismatching codes
are `values`' `nonstandard` and `sentinels` partitions.

Context.description: `shape.Context`: branding, artifact identity and headline counts for the SPA.

Coverage.description:
The span a variable or column is delivered over: its earliest start and latest
finite end (null when unknown, or when `open_ended`), and the states (held
periods in holdings) behind it.

DataWarning.description:
A retained source limitation or interpretation assumption: today's
`DataWarning`, as the build stored it.

warning_id.description: SHA-256 of the rest of the warning.

Delivery.description:
One `(variant, delivery column)` a variable is delivered under, with its disjoint
windows by start and their span. `column` is null for a state SCB named no
column for.

Derivation.description: A non-temporal derivation link between classifications.

DocDetail.description: A documentation entry: its metadata, a preview and the full markdown.

excerpt.description: The plain text's first 500 characters, for the SPA.

Error.description: The error document `{code, class, message, remediation, fields}` (section 7).

Family.description: A one-dimensional classification succession family (ICD, LKF, SNI, SSYK).

Group.description: A group as listed by its register, classification root or member classification.

Member.description: A group member; two members of one variable differ by `delivery_column`.

oneOf.description:
Present on a group's own page only: the member's coverage, its column's
for a representation member (empty when no state delivers the column).

PanelKey.description: A panel key: a variable slug (or `period`), or several (a composite key).

PeriodSpan.description: The first and last year of the steward's held periods.

Provider.description: A provider and its registers in scope.

Register.description: A register: its variables, concept groups and variants in scope.

RegisterCoverage.description: A register's span: its variables and the earliest and latest of their states.

RelatedDocument.description: A related document's metadata; the download route serves its bytes.

Root.description: The catalog root: the providers in scope and the classification root.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

Sizes.description: Browse-addressable (slugged) providers, registers and variables in the scope.

SourceRecordRef.description: One semantic source member a warning cites.

State.description:
A state: today's `VariableState` under the catalog page's light hydration (its
codes are the `values` facet).

coding_window_from.description: The coding window's start, for a column coded on its own.

period_token.description:
The coarsest period token of the bounds; `_default` when year-independent,
null when open-ended.

value_set.description: Always null: a state's codes are the `values` facet.

warning_ids.description: The data warnings that apply to this representation at its bounds.

StateClassification.description: A classification linked to a representation, with its stored conformance verdict.

Tag.description: A tag membership: the tag and this member's rank, star and note.

ValueSetSummary.description:
`value_set_summary`: a value set's code count and, when its codes are a dense
integer run, its span.

Variable.description:
A variable's shared metadata. Its states, lineage and succession chain are the
`states`, `lineage` and `graph` operations.

group.description: The ref of the concept group the variable belongs to.

same_as.description: The FQIDs of the variables curated as the same variable.

oneOf.description: Null in holdings for a variable with no held delivery.

deliveries.description: Every `(variant, column)` the variable is delivered under in scope.

Variant.description: A register variant (the `variant` filter of `states`), with its versions' prose.

variant_family.description: The key of the variant's succession family: its first head.
